evidence.reference_title: Pathogenic Variations of Homologous Recombination Gene HSF2BP Identified in Sporadic Patients With Premature Ovarian Insufficiency.
evidence.snippet: In this study, through the largest in-house WES database of 1,030 patients with sporadic POI, we identified two novel homozygous variations in HSF2BP (c.382T>C, p.C128R; c.557T>C, p.L186P).

nodes.description: The disease alleles reduce HSF2BP function without abolishing it. p.Ser167Leu lowers the protein level of HSF2BP and of its stabilizing partner BRME1, and p.Cys128Arg and p.Leu186Pro reduce its nuclear localization. HSF2BP binds a conserved region of BRCA2 between the BRC repeats and the DNA-binding domain, and the HSF2BP-BRME1 complex brings BRCA2 to meiotic double-strand breaks.

evidence.reference_title: HSF2BP Interacts with a Conserved Domain of BRCA2 and Is Required for Mouse Spermatogenesis.
evidence.snippet: The BRCA2-HSF2BP interaction is highly evolutionarily conserved and maps to armadillo repeats in HSF2BP and a 68-amino acid region between the BRC repeats and the DNA binding domain of human BRCA2 (Gly2270-Thr2337) encoded by exons 12 and 13.

evidence.reference_title: A meiosis-specific BRCA2 binding protein recruits recombinases to DNA double-strand breaks to ensure homologous recombination.
evidence.snippet: We conclude that localization of BRCA2 to meiotic DSBs is mediated by MEILB2, which is an integral mechanism to repair abundant meiotic DSBs.

nodes.description: There is no HSF2BP-directed therapy. As for other causes of POI, estrogen with progestogen replaces ovarian hormones to limit the bone, cardiovascular and other consequences of early estrogen loss; it does not restore fertility, for which donor oocytes are the usual option. The progestogen is bound as progesterone because the ChEBI progestogen class is a role term that the agent slot does not admit; other progestogens are equally used.

evidence.reference_title: Evidence-based guideline: Premature Ovarian Insufficiency.
evidence.snippet: Although hormone therapy (HT) can mitigate some of these effects

nodes.description: Mice homozygous for the human founding allele have fewer RAD51/DMC1 foci and crossovers in oocytes and a significant reduction in litters, but a normal follicle count.
Independent Hsf2bp (Meilb2) knockout lines are male-sterile with spermatocyte arrest; females are subfertile with fewer RAD51/DMC1 foci in oocytes and a large loss of follicles.

Without enough HSF2BP-BRME1, BRCA2 does not efficiently load RAD51 and DMC1 onto resected meiotic double-strand breaks. In knockout oocytes break formation and resection look normal (RPA2 foci), recombinase foci fall by about half, homolog synapsis is delayed, and fewer crossovers form. The defect is milder in oocytes than in spermatocytes, and Hsf2bp-null females remain fertile.
